description: A custom build of lodash library (version 3.10.1) with included 'template' and 'escape' functions, defining utility functions, template engine, and support features.

methods.name: lodash
methods.description: Constructor function for lodash wrapper, no operation performed.

methods.name: arrayEach
methods.description: Iterates over array elements, invoking iteratee, supports early exit.

methods.name: assignOwnDefaults
methods.description: Customizer for _.assign to assign default values if property is undefined.

methods.name: assignWith
methods.description: Assigns properties from source to object with customizer function.

methods.name: baseAssign
methods.description: Base implementation of _.assign without support for customizer.

methods.name: baseCopy
methods.description: Copies properties from source to object for specified keys.

methods.name: baseProperty
methods.description: Creates a function to access a property by key.

methods.name: baseValues
methods.description: Creates array of property values from object for given keys.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Gets 'length' property of object, used to avoid JIT bugs.

methods.name: getNative
methods.description: Retrieves native function at key if it is native.

methods.name: isArrayLike
methods.description: Checks if value is array-like.

methods.name: isIndex
methods.description: Checks if value is a valid array index.

methods.name: isIterateeCall
methods.description: Checks if arguments are from an iteratee call.

methods.name: isLength
methods.description: Checks if value is a valid array-like length.

methods.name: shimKeys
methods.description: Fallback for Object.keys, enumerates own properties.

methods.name: toObject
methods.description: Converts value to object if not one.

methods.name: restParam
methods.description: Creates a function that applies rest parameters.

methods.name: isArguments
methods.description: Checks if value is an arguments object.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if value is an Error object.

methods.name: isFunction
methods.description: Checks if value is a function.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if value is an object or function.

methods.name: isNative
methods.description: Checks if value is a native function.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if value is a string primitive or object.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Gets own enumerable property names of object.

methods.name: keysIn
methods.description: Gets own and inherited enumerable property names of object.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes HTML characters in string.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Compiles a template string into a function with delimiters for interpolation, escaping, and evaluation.

methods.name: attempt
methods.description: Attempts to invoke function, returns result or error.
